senses.def: to take care of someone or something
ex: She looks after her younger brother.
Can you look after my cat while I'm away?

mistake.wrong: I look after my keys but I can't find them.
mistake.right: I'm looking for my keys but I can't find them.
mistake.note: look after = يعتني. look for = يبحث عن.
